## How it was tested

- [ ] `make check` passes
- [ ] The CI gate passes, or the PR explains why the baseline should move
- [ ] Changes to the golden set: reviewed case by case, and `baselines/main.json` regenerated with `make baseline`
- [ ] Changes to the judge or its threshold: `evg calibrate` rerun and `judge-calibration.json` committed
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated
